promise.text: How to make a monthly budget for the first time

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "budget"

lines.text: Start with take-home income, real expenses, and bill dates.
Build a first monthly plan without counting two-week paychecks twice.

items.text: Gather recent bank and card statements, payslips, and current bills.
Write down take-home pay and the dates it will actually arrive.
List recurring bills, debt payments, and non-monthly costs.
Estimate groceries, transport, and other essentials from recent spending.
Add feasible savings and known future-cost reserves.
Subtract every planned line, then walk the balance through payment dates.

line.text: This is not a budget. It is one number for what is safe to spend, with nothing to categorise and no plan to stick to.
